title: Design: Clicking an invoiced Bill To shows a red toast with Go To Invoice
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new work order for this test for customer B billed to customer A that has been invoiced (Invoiced or Paid), so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Start on the work order page.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p3-04-after-click.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Bill To value.
  2. Click Go To Invoice in the toast.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A red error toast shows at the bottom right with a warning triangle and the white text "Invoiced. Reverse the invoice to change who's billed."
  • A white "Go To Invoice" button shows in the toast (the design also draws "Close": see Difference).

Step 2:

  • The work order's Finance tab opens and the invoice is not reversed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-R2: “Clicking or tapping the Invoiced field shows M4 as an error toast with a "Go To Invoice" button.”
  • S5-R3: “"Go To Invoice" opens the work order's or part sale's Finance tab; it never reverses anything.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "3 When the Bill To is blocked", pictures "Click" (This build).
